method: targeted source-English semantic review in adjacent verse context; checked against 180-dpi inventory-142 manuscript alignment candidates, without claiming diplomatic manuscript transcription

corrections.en: If you are Sarybai the brave,
corrections.reason: Эр is a heroic epithet, not the English title Mr.
Алыш is combat or wrestling; арбын intensifies the amount, not physical distance.
Кыймылдабай кылт этпей doubles the image of remaining absolutely still.
Кыйшаңдабай кылк этпей describes bodily stillness, not worry or inaction.

corrections.en: Close in and strike with your spear.
corrections.reason: Жетип найза уруңуз is an imperative to close the distance and thrust or strike with a spear.
Деп, ошентип introduces Kuyaly as the speaker; it is not an invitation to the reader.
Сүйлөөр сөздөн эринип means shrinking from or feeling reluctant to speak.
Аста сүйлөп кеп баштап means beginning to speak quietly or gently.
